WHATSAPP_TEMPLATE_MGMT.TITLE: Templates
WHATSAPP_TEMPLATE_MGMT.DESCRIPTION: View the message templates from your WhatsApp inboxes. You can create and edit text templates here; the rest is managed with your provider.
WHATSAPP_TEMPLATE_MGMT.SYNC_SUCCESS: Template sync started for all WhatsApp inboxes. Updates may take a couple of minutes.
WHATSAPP_TEMPLATE_MGMT.PARTIAL_SYNC_ERROR: Template sync started for some WhatsApp inboxes, but others could not be synced.
WHATSAPP_TEMPLATE_MGMT.SYNC_ERROR: Unable to start template sync. Please try again.
WHATSAPP_TEMPLATE_MGMT.FETCH_ERROR: Unable to load WhatsApp templates. Please try again.
WHATSAPP_TEMPLATE_MGMT.PARTIAL_FETCH_ERROR: Some WhatsApp templates could not be loaded. Please try again.

PREVIEW.TITLE: Template preview
PREVIEW.DESCRIPTION: Preview how this template appears in WhatsApp.

EDITOR.NO_INBOX: Creating templates requires a WhatsApp Cloud inbox connected to a business account.

CATEGORY.TITLE: Category
CATEGORY.DESCRIPTION: The category sets the price of each send and the rules WhatsApp applies to the message.
CATEGORY.AUTH_NOTE: Authentication templates follow a fixed format set by Meta and are created in the WhatsApp Manager.

MARKETING.LABEL: Marketing
MARKETING.HELP: Offers, news and anything meant to bring the customer back.

UTILITY.LABEL: Utility
UTILITY.HELP: Follow-up on something the customer asked for: an order, a booking, a payment.

TYPE.TITLE: Template type

STANDARD.LABEL: Text with buttons
STANDARD.HELP: Header, body, footer and up to 10 quick reply or link buttons.

TYPE.OTHERS_NOTE: Catalog, Flows, payment and contact-sharing templates are created in the WhatsApp Manager.

IDENTITY.TITLE: Identification
IDENTITY.NAME: Name
IDENTITY.NAME_HELP: Lowercase letters, numbers and underscore only. The customer never sees it.
IDENTITY.LOCKED: Name, language and inbox cannot be changed after the template is created.

CONTENT.TITLE: Content
CONTENT.BODY_HELP: Use variables for anything that changes with each send.
CONTENT.FOOTER_PLACEHOLDER: A closing line, with no variables

FORMAT.NOTE: Formatting works in the body only. WhatsApp does not format the header or the footer.

CONTENT.EXAMPLES_HELP: Meta requires one example per variable and reads it to understand your template. A real value helps approval; a generic one works against it.
CONTENT.EXAMPLE_PLACEHOLDER: A real value, e.g. Ana Souza

BUTTONS.TITLE: Buttons (optional)
BUTTONS.DESCRIPTION: Quick replies open a conversation; links take the customer to a page.

PREVIEW.TITLE: Preview
PREVIEW.VARIABLE_NOTE: Variables show as examples here; the real values go in when the message is sent.

NAME.FORMAT: Use lowercase letters, numbers and underscore only.

BODY.VARIABLE_ORDER: Number the variables from 1 with no gaps.
BODY.DANGLING: The body cannot start or end with a variable. Add fixed text around it.

HEADER.ONE_VARIABLE: The header takes at most one variable.

FOOTER.NO_VARIABLES: The footer does not accept variables.

BUTTONS.TOO_MANY: A template takes at most 10 buttons.
BUTTONS.URL_REQUIRED: A link button needs an address.

EXAMPLES.REQUIRED: Fill in an example for every variable.

UNSUPPORTED.TITLE: This template is edited in the WhatsApp Manager
UNSUPPORTED.NOT_FOUND: This template could not be loaded. Sync the templates and try again.
UNSUPPORTED.AUTHENTICATION: Authentication templates follow a fixed format set by Meta.
UNSUPPORTED.MEDIA_HEADER: This template has an image, video or document header, which this screen cannot rebuild.
UNSUPPORTED.EXTRA_COMPONENT: This template has content this screen cannot rebuild, and editing it here would drop that content.
UNSUPPORTED.BUTTON_TYPE: This template has a button type this screen cannot rebuild, such as call, copy code or Flow.
UNSUPPORTED.CATEGORY: This template uses a category Meta no longer accepts on new submissions, such as transactional or OTP.
UNSUPPORTED.STATUS: This template is still under review by Meta. Only approved, rejected or paused templates can be edited.

EDITOR.NEW_NOTE: The template goes to Meta for review and can only be used once approved.
EDITOR.EDIT_NOTE: Meta allows 1 edit every 24 hours and 10 every 30 days. An approved template is re-approved automatically unless it fails review.
EDITOR.SUBMITTED: Template sent to Meta for review.
EDITOR.FAILED: Meta did not accept the template. Please try again.

CONFIRM_DELETE.TITLE: Delete {name}?
CONFIRM_DELETE.DESCRIPTION: This cannot be undone. Meta deletes the template for good, and holds the name for 30 days before anyone can create another one with it. Messages already sent are not affected.
CONFIRM_DELETE.ERROR: Meta did not delete the template. Please try again.
